findings: This rebuild applies a full-manuscript tone revision: Abstract, Sections 1-5, 7, 8 and the appendices were rewritten for register, while Section 6 and References are unchanged verbatim. Numbers, tables, figures, citations and every recorded limitation were held fixed.

All 51 pages were rendered at 80 dpi and reviewed as six contact sheets (contact-1 through contact-6). No overlap, clipping, missing glyph, orphan heading, or table/figure overflow was found on any page.

Three pages were additionally rendered at 110 dpi and reviewed in detail: page 4 (title, Abstract and Figure 1), page 34 (Section 8 conclusion and the start of References) and page 36 (Appendix A and Appendix B tables). Text is fully justified, no line runs past the margins, and no literal markdown markup (asterisks, pipes) is rendered.
Page count stays 51 and page geometry stays A4 (595.276 x 841.89 pt).
Table rows rendered by pdfplumber remain inside page bounds on every page; no U+FFFD, box-drawing or NUL glyph was rendered.

Structural integrity of the rewrite was checked independently of the render: all 190 markdown table lines are byte-identical to the pre-rewrite manuscript as a multiset, the heading sequence is unchanged, and all Table/Figure/Section/Appendix cross-reference counts agree.
